title: RandomPotionChallenge
description: A plugin that gives a random Effect every 2 minutes good for manhunts twists!
body:
The Random Potion Challenge is a Minecraft Challenge where every 2 minutes, a random effect is applied to all players. Your objective is to kill all other players or even use it as a twist in a Manhunt or Hitman.

Each player will get a random effect from the config.

The hunger bar is auto disabled but can be enabled in the config as well.

When a player dies, they will be put into Spectator mode until the event ends, where they will be set back to native survival mode. Or you can disable that, so they just spawn back into survival for games like Manhunt or Hitman

You can customize the Duration and Amplitude of the Effects in config as well as add and remove some effects.

Once you enable the plugin all players teleport to spawn and their hunger and health restores as well as their inventories and effects get cleared. The same goes for when you end it.

**Permissions:**
RandomPotionChallenge.admin
Needed to use any command in the plugin.

**Commands:**

/RandomPotionChallenge on - Enables the challenge.

/RandomPotionChallenge off - Disables the challenge.


If you would like to use this plugin in a video on any platform, go for it I just request that you share this page.
